result.finding: Multi-stage Dockerfile with 2 stages. Final image has approximately 7-10 layers: base layers from eclipse-temurin:8-jre plus 1 COPY layer and 1 ENV layer added by the application.
evidence: 2 FROM instructions (multi-stage build): maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 (build stage), eclipse-temurin:8-jre (final stage)
Build stage: 2 COPY + 2 RUN instructions (4 layers, not carried to final image)
Final stage: 1 COPY --from=build instruction (carries only the JAR, not build tools)
ENV JAVA_OPTS instruction adds 1 layer to final image
WORKDIR, EXPOSE, ENTRYPOINT do not create layers in BuildKit mode
values: Build stage RUN instructions: 2 (not in final image)
